headline: Biomes are Earth's life zones—each with distinct climate, plants, and animals
universal_truth: Environment shapes what can thrive; match your nature to your environment or change one of them
fun_facts: There are roughly 10-15 major biomes on Earth, from tundra to tropical rainforest
Rainforests cover only 6% of Earth's surface but contain over half of all species
The same latitude can have very different biomes depending on ocean currents and altitude
discussion_questions: What 'biome' do you thrive in—work environment, social setting?
Have you ever been in the wrong environment for your nature?
How do you adapt to different environments?

hook.script: Polar bears don't live in deserts. Cacti don't grow in rainforests. Earth is divided into biomes—regions with distinct climates and life forms. Each biome selects for different traits. Environment determines what can thrive.

cliff.script: Species are matched to their biomes. Put them in the wrong one, and they struggle. What does this teach about environment and success?

options.text: Success depends heavily on environment fit—traits that succeed in one context may fail in another; matching your nature to your environment is strategic
options.response: Yes. A polar bear in a desert dies—not because it's a bad bear, but because it's in the wrong biome. Environment fit matters as much as individual ability.
Strength helps, but even the strongest are shaped by environment...

fact1.title: Climate Shapes Life
fact1.script: Temperature, rainfall, and seasons determine what can live where. Tropical rainforests are wet and warm—lush growth. Deserts are dry—specialized survivors. Climate sets the rules.

fact2.title: Local Adaptation
fact2.script: Each biome has species adapted to its specific conditions. Arctic foxes have thick fur. Desert plants store water. Adaptation to local conditions beats generic capability.

fact3.title: Finding Your Biome
fact3.script: You have a biome too—environments where you thrive. Some people flourish in competitive environments; others in collaborative ones. Finding the right environment unlocks potential.

wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Environment shapes what can thrive. Match your nature to your environment—or change one of them. Fit matters.

outro.script: That's Day 258. Tomorrow, we'll explore why variety matters—biodiversity. Until then, consider what environment brings out your best.

growTrack.title: Environment Audit - Where Do You Thrive?
growTrack.activity: What environments bring out your best? Fast-paced or steady? Social or solo? Structured or flexible? Are you currently in a biome that matches your nature? If not, can you change environment or adapt yourself?
